title: Species-level analysis availability
description: Species-level analysis availability, including the exact S22 projection of the conditional D. fuscus scale derived from the author-selected rounded 16.1-Gbp pooled assembly span at 0.978 Gbp per pg.
manuscript_use: Availability and audit table only; its projected picogram field is an assembly-derived sensitivity, not a measured C-value or independently calibrated absolute genome size.

title: Genomic TE resource panel
description: Frozen accession-explicit 34-species genomic TE panel.
manuscript_use: Primary TE descriptive denominator.

title: Finalized path-analysis panel
description: All 24 finalized cell, nucleus, and IOD species, including three manually reviewed below-target inclusions.
manuscript_use: Primary microscopy and cell-nucleus-genome path denominator.

title: Finalized Path24 conditional genome-size traits
description: Conditional D. fuscus assembly-anchored genome size in pg/1C, nucleus area, cell area, and support counts for all 24 finalized species.
manuscript_use: Primary three-trait input. Genome size is the default analysis trait but is IOD-derived and assembly-anchored, not an independent assay or measured C-value.

title: Assembly accessions and quality
description: NCBI accession-linked assembly span, N50, and contiguity metadata.
manuscript_use: Supports genomic-resource acquisition and QC.

title: dnaPipeTE input and accounting QC
description: Run counts, aligned bases, classification retention, and retry policy.
manuscript_use: Supports de novo TE analysis QC.

title: dnaPipeTE mass accounting
description: Species-level retained and unresolved aligned-base mass with equal weighting of retry runs.
manuscript_use: Primary dnaPipeTE denominator audit.

title: TE diversity summaries
description: A 34-row, four-column Wang-style TE-diversity table. For each species, the ten most abundant positive classified superfamilies were selected, reclosed to one, and summarized with natural-log Shannon and Gini-Simpson indices.
manuscript_use: Canonical paper-facing Shannon entropy and Gini-Simpson endpoints, matched to the Wang et al. top-10-superfamily scope. The species-specific top ten are explicitly reclosed in this study; Wang et al. did not document that normalization detail. Unresolved aligned-base mass remains only in S06-S07 QC.

title: TE compositional PCA scores
description: Species scores from the single 24-feature superfamily CLR-PCA fit after within-species retry averaging and restriction to superfamilies positive in all 34 species.
manuscript_use: Supports exploratory shared-superfamily ordination.

title: TE PCA explained variance
description: Eigenvalues and explained variance from the same superfamily CLR-PCA fit as S09 and S11.
manuscript_use: Supports PCA scree and axis labels.

title: TE PCA loadings
description: Superfamily loadings from the same 24-feature ubiquitous-superfamily CLR-PCA fit as S09 and S10.
manuscript_use: Supports biological interpretation of ordination axes.

title: RepeatMasker divergence landscape
description: Species- and order-level hit counts and aligned bases in one-percentage-point divergence bins.
manuscript_use: Primary repeat-landscape input.

title: RepeatMasker species inventory
description: Species-level hit counts, aligned bases, and detected TE orders.
manuscript_use: Supports RepeatMasker coverage/accounting.

title: Element-level terminal:internal depth metrics
description: Non-destructive zero-aware audit of 1,086 historically selected usable LTR elements, including corrected TEsorter domain counts, current LTR/Gypsy eligibility, regional coverage, IQR decisions, and primary membership.
manuscript_use: Exploratory deletion-footprint proxy; not an ectopic-recombination rate.

title: Species-level terminal:internal robustness
description: Species summaries across declared element branches, including the primary two-sided IQR-filtered regional-positive-depth branch and robust estimator diagnostics.
manuscript_use: Robustness analysis for the exploratory proxy.

title: LTR resource coverage
description: Per-species LTR resource audit separating historical pipe-split counts from correct LTR/Gypsy five-domain eligibility, IQR retention, coverage, and primary support.
manuscript_use: Defines LTR analysis support.

title: Excluded LTR elements
description: Two source-corrupt rows from the historical pipe-split cohort; both have four real TEsorter domain annotations and are audit-only under the corrected gate.
manuscript_use: Reviewer audit trail.

title: Finalized reviewed cell-nucleus objects
description: All 1,152 manually reviewed cell/nucleus pairs across 24 species; below-target species retain their available accepted objects.
manuscript_use: Object-level source for cell and nucleus area estimates.

title: Cell and nucleus species estimates
description: Upper-tail species medians, conditional paired-object bootstrap intervals, and animal/image support from all 24 finalized reviewed panels.
manuscript_use: Primary descriptive morphology table; intervals are conditional on observed animals and images and are not population-level uncertainty.

title: Below-target cell-mask review audit
description: Manual keep/problem decisions used to finalize D. aeneus, D. orestes, and D. wrighti without treating 50 objects as an exclusion threshold.
manuscript_use: Reviewer reconstruction of the three below-target inclusions.

title: Finalized reviewed nuclear-IOD objects
description: All 805 reviewed nuclei retained across the 24-species image-quality-matched panel as the object-level IOD measurement and calibration substrate.
manuscript_use: Object-level IOD measurement and calibration audit; not a separate downstream relative-IOD analysis branch.

title: Relative nuclear-IOD species estimates
description: Equal-image means of within-image median nuclear IOD, the retained Path24-median relative audit index, and the conditional D. fuscus genome-size scale used by downstream analyses, derived from the selected rounded 16.1-Gbp pooled assembly span at 0.978 Gbp per pg.
manuscript_use: IOD fields retain measurement and calibration provenance. Conditional picogram fields supply the default downstream genome-size trait, but are not a measured C-value; their intervals exclude uncertainty in the chosen assembly anchor.

title: Unnormalized image-level nuclear IOD
description: Unnormalized image-specific nuclear-IOD summaries used to construct and audit the equal-image species estimator.
manuscript_use: Image-level IOD measurement and aggregation audit; values are neither ratios nor independent genome-size measurements.

title: Nuclear-IOD quality balance
description: Species-level support and balance against the apalachicolae quality template; the declared gate is absolute SMD <= 0.10 and KS distance <= 0.25.
manuscript_use: Underlying IOD support and image-quality audit for genome-size use.

title: Nuclear-IOD quality diagnostics
description: Within-species-centered associations between image-quality features and log nuclear IOD, retained as descriptive confounding diagnostics.
manuscript_use: Underlying IOD assay-quality audit for genome-size use.

title: Conditional genome-size pairwise PGLS sensitivity
description: Raw correlations and Pagel-lambda PGLS fits among conditional D. fuscus assembly-anchored genome size, nucleus area, and cell area.
manuscript_use: Conditional genome-size association sensitivity; the trait is IOD-derived and not an independent genome-size assay.

title: Standardized Path24 conditional genome-size traits
description: Log10-transformed and standardized conditional genome size, nucleus area, and cell area for the 24-species primary fit.
manuscript_use: Primary path-analysis trait matrix on the conditional D. fuscus assembly-anchored genome-size scale; not an independent assay.

title: Pairwise conditional-genome-size phylogenetic regressions
description: Scale-invariant pairwise phylogenetic regressions among conditional genome size, nucleus area, and cell area.
manuscript_use: Exploratory associations on the IOD-derived conditional genome-size scale.

title: Conditional genome-size evolutionary-model sensitivity
description: Conditional genome-size path-model rankings under the declared phylogenetic evolutionary models.
manuscript_use: Evolutionary-model sensitivity audit; genome size is assembly-anchored and IOD-derived rather than independently assayed.

title: Conditional genome-size path-model comparison
description: Global fit, CICc, delta, and weights for the finalized 24-species conditional genome-size analysis.
manuscript_use: Exploratory association structures only; conditional genome size is not an independent assay and equivalence classes do not orient a unique causal arrow.

title: Conditional genome-size mechanism edge estimates
description: Standardized coefficients and intervals for the three Markov-equivalent conditional-genome-size mechanisms.
manuscript_use: Exploratory edge estimates; no unique causal orientation or independent genome-size assay claim.

title: Conditional genome-size path-model stability
description: Top-model and competitive-model frequencies across fitted conditional genome-size sensitivity analyses.
manuscript_use: Exploratory stability summary on the IOD-derived conditional scale.

title: Conditional genome-size path tree sensitivity
description: Conditional genome-size model rankings across the declared focal and published-tree sensitivity fits.
manuscript_use: Tree uncertainty audit; the primary focal-tree fit retains all 24 species and uses the IOD-derived conditional genome-size trait.

title: Conditional genome-size path measurement sensitivity
description: Conditional genome-size model rankings across 250 measurement-bootstrap replicates of the finalized 24-species panel.
manuscript_use: Measurement-model audit for the conditional genome-size analysis.

title: Conditional genome-size path leave-one-species-out analysis
description: Conditional genome-size model rankings after omitting each of the 24 finalized species in turn.
manuscript_use: Species-influence audit for the conditional genome-size analysis.

title: Conditional genome-size path simulation calibration
description: Recovery and false-selection summaries for the declared conditional genome-size simulation regimes.
manuscript_use: Calibration gate; blocks confirmatory or uniquely causal interpretation.

title: Primary conditional genome-size d-separation tests
description: Basis-set tests for the finalized 24-species conditional genome-size candidate models.
manuscript_use: Global-fit and identifiability audit; no independent-assay or unique-causal-arrow claim.

title: Focal phylogeny edge list
description: Reviewer-readable CSV representation of the exact 24-tip focal Newick tree.
manuscript_use: Tree reconstruction and audit.

title: Focal phylogeny node table
description: Reviewer-readable CSV representation of the exact 24-tip focal Newick tree.
manuscript_use: Tree reconstruction and audit.

analysis_section: Integrated TE and conditional genome size
title: TE diversity and conditional genome size overlap
description: Exact 21-species TE34-by-Path24 overlap joining canonical species-specific top-10-superfamily Shannon entropy and Gini-Simpson values to conditional D. fuscus assembly-anchored genome size and intervals.
manuscript_use: Descriptive integrated sensitivity table only; genome size is IOD-derived rather than an independent assay or validated absolute C-value.

title: Wang 2025 and current top-10-superfamily TE diversity
description: Descriptive cross-study plotting table containing the 84 exact CC0 Dryad Figure 2 rows from Wang et al. 2025 and 34 current Desmognathus rows recomputed over each species' ten most abundant positive superfamilies.
manuscript_use: Auxiliary descriptive context only. Published RepeatModeler/RepeatMasker and current dnaPipeTE inputs come from different pipelines; no pooled regression, hypothesis test, or estimator-equivalence claim is permitted. Current genome sizes are conditional D. fuscus-anchored IOD-derived sensitivities, not direct C-values.

title: TE34 Bonsai tip annotations
description: Exact 34-species tip annotation table for the pinned Bonsai TE-composition representation, including expert reproductive-strategy labels for every species.
manuscript_use: Supplies Figure 2 tip labels and post-hoc reproductive-strategy colors. The representation is not a species phylogeny, and annotation timing precludes a confirmatory trait-association claim.

title: TE34 Bonsai reproductive-strategy validation
description: Three-row publication summary of fixed-tree strategy localization and 200 bounded feature-resampling Bonsai refits for the TE34 representation.
manuscript_use: Supplies Figure 2 validation annotations and exact-edge stability. Label tests are post hoc, and coordinate resampling is a feature perturbation rather than a biological-specimen bootstrap.
